title: Spock says you can go around time

tellings.quote: So but he said you can go around time and I didn't really understand when

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US government's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells a podcast host about his time at an overseas base in the early 1990s, connected to a secret program he refers to by the letters PPD. Sherman says a figure he calls Spock told him that you can go around time, and that he did not really understand it then. If true, it would hint that whoever he was talking to treated time in a way we do not.
